---
title: "11 · Permissions and trust boundaries"
---

Which components are authorized to change state?

## Concepts

Draw where untrusted inputs cross into model context or into a tool handler. Put access decisions at the tool boundary. Specify least privilege, approval gates for consequential effects, and audit records.

## Study task

Assign the proposer write access to candidate configurations and the evaluator read access to isolated fixtures. Write denial cases for attempted edits to the evaluator and unauthorized promotion requests.

## Deliverable

Submit a data-flow diagram, a capability matrix, and expected test outcomes for each denied write.
